# Baker Co.

> Baker Co. specializes in custom-engineered laboratory safety equipment with over 100 years of industry expertise.

Baker Co. is a leader in made-to-order laboratory safety solutions, serving scientific research institutions and facilities worldwide. The company combines decades of engineering experience with personalized service through dedicated sales specialists to deliver tailored equipment solutions.
